options.reason: The active Ruby package exists, has provider fixture coverage, and preserves a useful native Psych backend identity.

options.description: Keep psych-merge only as an old-name alias for yaml-merge.

options.description: Keep psych-merge as the Ruby/Psych provider package for the YAML family.
